title: Software Engineer | Python, AI Cluster, Test Automation | 4-8 years
description:
Meet The Team

Cisco Validated Infrastructure Services (CVIS) establishes and proves the performance of large AI clusters before they are handed over to customers. We deploy each cluster, validate it against performance baselines, and deliver the evidence that it is ready for service. The platform behind that work is full stack. It combines workflow and API services, network and infrastructure automation, and the UI used to run validation across labs and customer environments. 

Your Impact

As a Release Software Engineer, you will own the release lifecycle for CVIS/NVIS software across AI clusters. You will take every build from integration through Jenkins-driven, end-to-end automated testing on AI cluster environments to test planning, acceptance criteria, RA certification, release qualification and readiness.

- AI cluster releases meet documented functional, performance, interoperability and reliability gates.
- Results are reproducible and traceable to specific Jenkins builds. They are packaged for engineering, support and customer readiness.
- Critical AI cluster regressions are caught early in the Jenkins pipeline and resolved with actionable evidence.

Release operations: Drive CVIS releases through each stage, from integration and automated Jenkins test runs to final readiness. Enforce release gates in Jenkins pipelines covering GPU, NCCL, network-fabric and workload validation, and keep release status transparent to all stakeholders.

Minimum Qualification

- Ability to turn AI cluster system requirements into measurable tests, acceptance criteria and release gates
- Clear technical writing and strong cross-functional communication
- Test automation in Python or a similar language, built into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins-file, shared libraries, job orchestration) that validate AI cluster deployments
- Linux skills for debugging compute, GPU, network and storage issues in AI clusters
- Track AI cluster feature readiness across releases, using Jenkins build and test results as evidence

Why Cisco? 
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
- begin with screening or an interview
- originate from a Cisco email address, and
- be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx
 
Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Testing Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Software Testing Engineer with 34 years of experience who can take ownership of the end-to-end quality of our products.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in manual and automated testing, API testing, UI testing, mobile/web/desktop application testing, performance and reliability testing, and test automation frameworks.

The role requires someone who can understand the complete product and technology stack, identify risks early, design effective test strategies, and ensure that products are reliable, scalable, secure, and production-ready.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the **end-to-end testing and quality assurance** of software products.
* Understand product requirements, technical specifications, user flows, and system architecture.
* Create comprehensive **test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios**.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and acceptance testing.
* Develop and maintain **automated test suites** for web, mobile, desktop, and backend applications.
* Design and execute API and service-level testing.
* Validate end-to-end workflows across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, third-party services, and cloud infrastructure.
* Identify edge cases, failure scenarios, security risks, and potential production issues.
* Perform cross-browser and cross-platform testing.
* Test mobile applications across different devices, OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions.
* Work closely with developers to reproduce, debug, and resolve defects.
* Participate in requirement reviews and technical design discussions to identify quality risks **before development is completed**.
* Integrate automated tests into **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Maintain test environments, test data, automation frameworks, and testing documentation.
* Perform performance and scalability testing for critical product workflows.
* Monitor production issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and prevention of recurring defects.
* Continuously improve testing processes, automation coverage, and engineering quality standards.

**Education & Experience**

1. Experience: Skilled (4-5 years)

2. Qualification: B.Tech CSE

**Technical Skills:**

* **3–4 years of professional experience** in software testing / QA / SDET / test automation.
* Strong understanding of **software testing methodologies and SDLC/STLC**.
* Hands-on experience with both **manual and automated testing**.
* Strong programming/scripting skills in at least one language such as:
* Java
* Python
* JavaScript/TypeScript
* C++
* or similar
* Experience with UI automation frameworks such as:
* Selenium
* Playwright
* Cypress
* Appium
* or equivalent frameworks
* Strong experience with **API testing** using tools/frameworks such as Postman, REST Assured, Playwright, pytest, or similar.
* Experience testing **web applications, mobile applications, and backend services**.
* Good understanding of SQL and databases for data validation.
* Experience with Git and version-control workflows.
* Experience integrating automated tests with **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Strong understanding of defect management, root-cause analysis, and test reporting.

**Automation Testing:**

The candidate should be capable of building and maintaining a **robust automation framework**, rather than only writing individual automated test cases.

Experience should include:

* Page Object Model / equivalent design patterns
* Data-driven and parameterized testing
* API automation
* UI automation
* Mobile automation
* Parallel test execution
* Test reporting
* Test data management
* Environment configuration
* Automated regression suites
* CI/CD integration
* Flaky-test identification and reduction

**End-to-End Product Testing:**

The candidate should understand how different components of a modern product interact and should

be able to test complete workflows across:

**Frontend API Backend Services Database External Services Cloud Infrastructure**

They should be comfortable identifying failures that may not be visible at the UI level and validating data and behavior across the entire system.

**Testing Across Platforms**

The candidate should have working knowledge of testing applications across multiple environments:

* **Web:** Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge
* **Mobile:** Android and iOS
* **Desktop:** Windows/macOS/Linux applications where applicable
* **Backend:** REST/gRPC APIs and services
* **Cloud:** Applications deployed on AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar environments

**Performance & Scalability Testing**

Experience with performance testing is preferred, including:

* Load testing
* Stress testing
* Endurance testing
* Scalability testing
* Concurrent-user testing
* API performance testing
* Response-time analysis
* Bottleneck identification

Experience with tools such as **JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar** is a plus.
